_encoding: u64 fields are JSON strings; numbers above 2^53 lose precision through JSON.parse. init-spot-markets.ts converts via BN(string).

_fields.optimal_borrow_rate: borrow APR at the kink, 1e6 = 100% (e.g. 100000 = 10% APR)
_fields.min_borrow_rate: floor APR, u8 in 0.5% units (2 = 1%); null = leave program default
_fields.imf_factor: imf margin scaling with position size, 1e6
_fields.scale_initial_asset_weight_start: deposits TVL (USD 1e6) above which initial asset weight starts scaling down; 0 = never
_fields.withdraw_guard_threshold: token amount (mint decimals) below which withdraw guards do not bind
_fields.order_tick_size: spot order price tick, PRICE_PRECISION 1e6; init-only, not synced on existing markets
_fields.order_step_size: spot order size step, mint decimals; init-only, not synced on existing markets
_fields.if_total_factor: share of borrow interest routed to the insurance fund, 1e6
_fields.max_token_deposits: deposit cap, token amount in mint decimals; 0 = uncapped
_fields.max_token_borrows_fraction: borrow cap as fraction of max_token_deposits, 1e4 = 100%; 0 = uncapped
